metadata.limitations: Current geometry vintage and source-chart age; candidate functional berth attribution; incomplete ENC artificial-quay coverage, interpreted corridors retained; coarse channel interpretations; offshore acquisition truncation. High geometry sensitivity is reported, not hidden.
metadata.refinement_basis: January pilot visual audit found hand-locator undercoverage; supplemented LA/Savannah interpreted corridors with NOAA ENC outlines and replaced NY named terminals with actual facility outlines, without changing speed/gap/persistence or forecast design
